facts.fact: Ordonnance N° 0006/PR/2025 portant réglementation de la Digitalisation en République Gabonaise (an ordinance of the President, signed 12 August 2025 and published in Journal Officiel n°81 of 30 August 2025) applies to all State services and to public and private bodies; its art. 3 lists secure sharing of data and art. 6 says digitalisation facilitates sharing and exchange of data, and art. 9 states that information systems must be interoperable; art. 19 leaves implementing provisions to further regulatory texts.

note: No duty fact: the text requires information systems to be interoperable (art. 9) but states no express obligation to exchange data, and cites no implementing text.
